page_title: REI 1-1 LYO | Reims v Lyon 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+2' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Oumar Diakite is replaced by Amine Salama (Reims).
90+2' The substitution is prepared. Gabriel Moscardo (Reims) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Valentin Atangana Edoa.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Malick Fofana (Lyon) jumps into a tackle and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
86' Malick Fofana (Lyon) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Yehvann Diouf, who pulls off a decent save!
85' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
84' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) picks up an injury.
83' Junya Ito (Reims) commits a rough foul. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and makes a call.
82' Keito Nakamura (Reims) is adjudged offside.
81' A cross from Junya Ito (Reims) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
80' Cedric Kipre (Reims) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Stephanie Frappart ignores the protests.
79' Substitution. Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) on for Said Benrahma.
79' Substitution. Nemanja Matic did his best and is replaced by Tanner Tessmann (Lyon).
77' Substitution. Nhoa Sangui leaves the pitch and is replaced by Buta (Reims).
70' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Teddy Teuma (Reims) replacing Amadou Kone.
68' Ernest Nuamah comes off the pitch to be replaced by Malick Fofana (Lyon).
65' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) makes a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Amadou Kone (Reims) is booked.
63' The current number of shots on goal is 4:5.
58' Junya Ito (Reims) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
57' Referee Stephanie Frappart sees the trip by Abner (Lyon) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
55' 1 - 1 Oumar Diakite (Reims) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes into the bottom right corner.
52' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
50' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stephanie Frappart signals.
49' The linesman raises his flag. Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is adjudged offside.
48' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Junya Ito (Reims) works the corner short.
44' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is penalised for holding. Stephanie Frappart signals a set piece.
42' Keito Nakamura (Reims) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.

38' 0 - 1 Alexandre Lacazette sends a superb cross into the box. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header inside the right post, leaving Yehvann Diouf beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:1.
38' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
37' Junya Ito (Reims) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
37' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lucas Perri intercepts the ball. Reims have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
28' The resulting corner from Junya Ito (Reims) comes to nothing.
27' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Reims can continue in their attacking effort.
25' Sergio Akieme (Reims) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stephanie Frappart saw the whole situation.
22' Clinton Mata (Lyon) tackles a bit over-zealously and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
21' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
21' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
17' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Yehvann Diouf thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lyon comes to nothing.
15' Keito Nakamura (Reims) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
13' Said Benrahma (Lyon) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stephanie Frappart no option but to blow his whistle.
12' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
9' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
8' The goal by Lyon won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
8' Wait! Referee Stephanie Frappart has indicated he is going to review the Lyon goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
7' Said Benrahma (Lyon) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
